archive_cycles.limitation: Complete timestamp partitions only. Commit attempts include cooperative retries; stage span is not independent of owner/transaction time. Ready mark precedes Future.set_result by callback bookkeeping. Child clocks are common-host monotonic. Final commit-to-consumed includes native successor snapshot and arbiter completion. Incomplete flights are excluded rather than reconstructed from counters.

owner_time.limitation: Native-stage wall includes the identical COMMIT floor and embedded wrappers; commit floor is also recorded separately. Source-floor actual wait includes scheduler oversleep. Source stages/outer transactions/owner service must not be added as independent occupancy.
